name: Lyonesse
lore: Lyonesse, Tristan's country, drowned by the sea - and the sea is rising again under a white storm out of the south, the white dragon's weather. The drowned folk live their last day over and over, the priests of Arawn bargain at the ruined cathedral, and the cailleach keeps her ring in the mire. Only the Remnant's camp on the south-east rise is quiet.

chains.title: The Drowned Knights
chains.hint: Armour glints in the drowned keep...

stages.name: Clear Sunken Keep
stages.objective: Clear the sunken keep
stages.announce: The Black Knight has mustered the drowned garrison. Break it before it marches inland.
stages.success: You have cleared the sunken keep. The Black Knight of Lyonesse comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the sunken keep. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Black Knight of Lyonesse
stages.objective: Defeat the Black Knight of Lyonesse
stages.announce: The Black Knight of Lyonesse stands at the sunken keep. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Black Knight of Lyonesse falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Black Knight of Lyonesse slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Footmans Hold the Road
stages.objective: Drive the footmans off the road
stages.announce: With The Drowned Knights lost, the footmans have spread down onto the road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The footmans are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Hal, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Hal has come out to set the road right. The footmans are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The footmans break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Hal falls, and the footmans take the road back.

chains.title: The Peallaidh Flood
chains.hint: The water is rising in the north...

stages.name: Protect Old Tamsin
stages.objective: Protect Old Tamsin, who is driving her flock to higher ground
stages.announce: The peallaidh are raising the water. Old Tamsin is driving her flock to higher ground - keep them off her.
stages.success: "That's done," says Old Tamsin. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Old Tamsin falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Shepherd's Fold
stages.objective: Clear the shepherd's fold
stages.announce: They came from the shepherd's fold. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the shepherd's fold. The Drowned Peallaidh comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the shepherd's fold. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Drowned Peallaidh
stages.objective: Defeat the Drowned Peallaidh

stages.success: The Drowned Peallaidh falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Drowned Peallaidh slips away - for now.

stages.announce: With The Peallaidh Flood lost, the peallaidhs have spread down onto the road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The peallaidhs are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Edith, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Edith has come out to set the road right. The peallaidhs are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The peallaidhs break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Edith falls, and the peallaidhs take the road back.

chains.title: The Moorlich Mire
chains.hint: A green light burns over the mire...

stages.name: Clear Moorlich Mire
stages.objective: Clear the moorlich mire
stages.announce: The moorliches have gathered in the mire around their master. Put him down.
stages.success: You have cleared the moorlich mire. The Lich of the Sunken Moor comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the moorlich mire. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Lich of the Sunken Moor
stages.objective: Defeat the Lich of the Sunken Moor
stages.announce: The Lich of the Sunken Moor stands at the moorlich mire. Bring friends.

boss.name: The Lich of the Sunken Moor

stages.success: The Lich of the Sunken Moor falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Lich of the Sunken Moor slips away - for now.

chains.title: The Black Hound of Lyonesse
chains.hint: Hounds bay across the drowned land at dusk...

stages.name: Protect Shepherd Elowen
stages.objective: Protect Shepherd Elowen, who is driving her flock to the fold
stages.announce: The Gabriel hounds are hunting on the moor tonight, and Elowen is still out with her flock. Keep them off her.
stages.success: "That's done," says Shepherd Elowen. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Shepherd Elowen falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Hounds' Den
stages.objective: Clear the hounds' den
stages.announce: They came from the hounds' den. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the hounds' den. The Black Hound comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the hounds' den. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Black Hound
stages.objective: Defeat the Black Hound
stages.announce: The Black Hound stands at the hounds' den. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Black Hound falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Black Hound slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Gabriel Hounds Hold the Old Road
stages.objective: Drive the gabriel hounds off the old road
stages.announce: With The Black Hound of Lyonesse lost, the gabriel hounds have spread down onto the old road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The gabriel hounds are gone from the old road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Mabyn, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Mabyn has come out to set the old road right. The gabriel hounds are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the old road is safe again. Thank you."

stages.fail: Roadwarden Mabyn falls, and the gabriel hounds take the road back.

chains.title: The White Storm
chains.hint: A white storm out of a clear sky over the north rock - and something is moving inside it...

stages.name: The Storm-Line
stages.objective: Break the storm-callers and the sea-things on the north rock
stages.announce: The white storm has come ashore on the north rock, and the storm-callers are singing it bigger! Break them!
stages.success: The singing stops - and the storm draws itself together into a shape, white as bone, with wings.
stages.fail: The storm rolls inland over Lyonesse.

stages.name: the Storm-Wyrm
stages.objective: Bring down the Storm-Wyrm
stages.announce: The Storm-Wyrm - the white dragon's weather given a body - coils over the rock. It's a fight for a group, and more.
stages.success: The Storm-Wyrm tears apart into rain, and the rain is only rain. Far to the south, a dragon screams.
stages.fail: The Storm-Wyrm rolls inland, and the sea rises behind it.

stages.name: The Storm Holds the North Shore
stages.objective: Drive the storm's creatures off the north shore
stages.announce: The white storm's creatures have come ashore and hold the north shore.
stages.success: The road is clear again.

chains.title: The Black Sail
chains.hint: A ship with a sail half black, half white, is coming in to the old harbour - and it's crewed by the drowned...

stages.name: The Harbour
stages.objective: Keep Harper Morwenna alive while she sings the ship in
stages.announce: Isolde's ghost-ship is coming in to the old harbour, as it does once a year! Harper Morwenna of the Harpers has gone to sing it in - and its drowned crew will take her for an enemy.
stages.thanks: "She's in. She's always in, in the song. Now she's in, in the world."
stages.success: The ship grinds onto the sand - and its drowned captain steps down, still waiting for Tristan.
stages.fail: Morwenna falls, and the ship sails out again.

stages.name: the Black Sail's Captain
stages.objective: Lay the Black Sail's captain to rest
stages.announce: The ship's captain, drowned three hundred years: 'Is he alive? She bade me hurry. Is he alive?' He won't hear the answer. Bring friends.
stages.success: The captain sinks to his knees on the sand. 'Tell her I hurried,' he says. The ship is gone at dawn.
stages.fail: The ship sails out on the tide.
